title: WorkPlan
description: Output of solidsdd.decompose: requirement sliced into verifiable work items for solidsdd-run (distinct from ApplicationPlan). Acceptance criteria are Gherkin Scenarios.

summary.description: Short human-readable summary of the decomposition.

acceptance_of_whole.description: Overall completion condition checked by the final solidsdd-verify after all items. Prefer a Gherkin Scenario or an explicit conjunction of scenario names.

id.description: Stable id within this WorkPlan (e.g. W1).

intent.description: Change intent passed into one solidsdd-loop run for this slice.

acceptance_criterion.description: Exactly one Gherkin Scenario (or one independently checkable Scenario Outline slice) with Given/When/Then. Not free-form prose alone.

feature_path.description: Optional path to requirements/**/*.feature containing this scenario.

scenario_name.description: Optional Scenario name matching the Feature file.

depends_on.description: Other item ids that must be done before this item is ready.
